topic_chains.mechanism: A discourse topic introduced with 'は' in an initial sentence remains active across multiple subsequent sentences until explicitly superseded by a new 'は' topic.
topic_chains.anaphora_recovery: All downstream sentences with omitted subjects (zero pronouns) automatically anchor their null argument to the active topic chain.

cohesion_without_pronouns.strategy: Instead of overt third-person pronouns (he, she, they), Japanese maintains textual cohesion through demonstratives (これ, それ, あれ, そのN, あのN), zero pronouns, and reiteration of social titles (部長, 先生).

register_shifts.triggers: Speakers modulate politeness levels dynamically based on emotional proximity, topic seriousness, or institutional shifts (e.g., slipping into casual plain form when uttering an internal thought / monologue, then restoring Keigo to interlocutor).
